output.summary: An evergreen shrub or tree originating in Southeast Asia, rose-apple has glossy mature leaves and white or greenish-white flowers with many long stamens. Its ripe fruit has a strong floral scent, crisp watery flesh and usually one or two loose seeds; it is eaten raw, cooked in regional recipes or served with spiced sugar in Southeast Asia.
output.edibilityNote: The ripe fruit is eaten raw or cooked in regional recipes and is often served with spiced sugar in Southeast Asia.
